creative_direction: Create a shell-shaped art-deco terrace pavilion beside a quiet lake. The shell canopy opens toward the viewer with broad blue ribs and warm ivory inner planes. Avoid instruments, crowds, or text; the pavilion alone supplies the focal shape. Use painterly architectural concept art. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
